$comment: ARIA Email Draft — Teams Action.Submit payload schema reference
When the Teams bot receives an Action.Submit from the email-draft card it must:
1. Read the 'action' field to route the request.
2. For action == 'copy': invoke Teams clipboard API (desktop) or display a
copy-friendly TextBlock (mobile). No API call is needed.
3. For action == 'regenerate': POST to /api/chat with the body shown in
'regenerateApiRequest' below. The bot must forward the user's Entra bearer
token (the same token used for the initial chat turn) in the Authorization header.
The 'draft' and 'previousDraft' fields are the full EmailDraft JSON object serialised
as a string by the card template and parsed back to an object by the bot before the
API call. Do not pass them as raw strings to the API.
Desktop vs mobile differences
Desktop Teams: Action.Submit fires automatically when the user clicks 'Copy draft'
or types an instruction and clicks 'Regenerate'.
Mobile Teams: same card renders in a single-column layout. The Input.Text for the
regenerate instruction stacks below the body. Behaviour is identical.

copyPayload.$comment: Payload the bot receives when the user clicks 'Copy draft'.

draft.subject: Request for Additional Annual Leave
draft.body:
Dear [Name],

I am writing to request additional annual leave beyond my standard entitlement...

Kind regards,
[Your name]

regeneratePayload.$comment: Payload the bot receives when the user clicks 'Regenerate'.

previousDraft.subject: Request for Additional Annual Leave
previousDraft.body:
Dear [Name],

I am writing to request additional annual leave beyond my standard entitlement...

Kind regards,
[Your name]

The bot maps emailDraft back to a new email-draft.json card and updates the card in the channel.
